note: Reviewed root causes of the Phase 4e (phpBlog) differences tools/runtime/classify.py cannot tie to a flag at their node. Keyed by page and difference path (compare.py; "*" = every difference of the page); `rules` = the rules version of the run. A finding with a class other than UNEXPLAINED is a hand-reviewed link (its evidence names the flag and the node); UNEXPLAINED stays UNEXPLAINED. `rules` may list several versions: phpBlog's generated pages are the same under v1.0 and v1.1 before change 4 (normalised bodies compared, Phase 4f), and these findings were re-checked on the change-4 run. `data`: the database the finding was reviewed on (one name or a list; "seed", the default: install/database.sql; "fixture": seed + initdb/03-fixture.sql, Phase 4f; classify.py --data). A difference path depends on the data: with the fixture's featured post the carousel renders, and the Recent Posts row moves from div[0] to div[1]. The install, login.php and blog.php footer findings were re-checked on the fixture run: the same paths, values and root causes.

findings.rootCause: The legacy page stops with a PHP fatal error after its first line: install/upgrade-v2.2.php:46 queries a `settings` table that install/database.sql does not create (PHP 8: uncaught mysqli_sql_exception, tools/runtime/phpblog/build/logs/errors.log). Before that, line 41 tries to rewrite ../config.php on a plain GET (blocked: the file is mounted read-only). The generated page prints every message. Caused by the run (an upgrade script run against a fresh install), not by the tool.

unsoundDecisions.where: phpBlog core.php:652 (the shell, every public page: 35 differences) and blog.php:29 (2 differences)
unsoundDecisions.what: An if / else whose condition is not translatable: spec section 6 generates unresolvedCondition (false), so the ternary renders the else arm on every request. core.php:652 `if ($logged == 'No') { Sign In | Register } else { Profile menu }`: the logged-in Profile menu is shown to an anonymous visitor (the browser shows Sign In). blog.php:29 `if ($count <= 0) { 'There are no published posts' } else { the posts loop and its pagination }` (R-I2: the loop is the else arm): the empty list and its pagination are shown, the legacy page shows the message (the seed has no posts). Classified flag-but-wrong:unresolvedCondition (37 differences). Root cause (ii): a v1.1 spec rule (section 6: unresolvedCondition is false, also where it selects an else arm) produced a wrong result. Not fixed (rules v1.1 final): a post-freeze finding under v1.1, for the owner.
unsoundDecisions.fixedBy: post-freeze change 4 (spec v0.16, Phase 4f): the if / else now renders one flagged gap (C2Todo) and its arms are kept in an unused Arms_<id>() function
unsoundDecisions.correction: Phase 4f, by hand: core.php:652 36 differences, blog.php:29 1. The classifier tied the menu's icon (<i class="fas fa-user">) to blog.php's else arm, which prints the same start tag; the class and the total (37) are unchanged. Seed + fixture: 36, all core.php:652 (blog.php's else arm is the browser's arm when there are posts). docs/phase4-results.md section 5.3
